Resistor in an AC circuit: the current phasor is in phase with the voltage phasor

Animation. On the left, two phasors rotate together counter-clockwise about the origin: the voltage phasor V0 in blue and the current phasor I0 in red, half as long, their labels turning with them. On the right, their projections on the y axis, v_R(t) in blue and i_R(t) in red, are traced out against time as sine waves that peak together. A small schematic shows an AC source driving a resistor.
